observations.finding: 18 of 50 tested pathways significant; top pathways include ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD=0.785, up), IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING (SMD=0.757, up), HEME_METABOLISM (SMD=-0.556, down), MYC_TARGETS_V2 (SMD=0.645, up), E2F_TARGETS (SMD=0.599, up).
BAP1 mutation frequency 24% vs 1.9% in rest; OR=16.42 (95% CI 2.05-131.77), Fisher p=0.0007, q=0.0157.
PBRM1 mutation frequency 52% vs 24.5% in rest; OR=3.33 (95% CI 1.44-7.69), Fisher p=0.0048, q=0.0526 (not significant at q<0.05).
chr9q lower in set, Cliff's delta=-0.466, q=0.0031.
CDKN2A loss frequency 42% vs 7.5% in rest; OR=8.87 (95% CI 2.77-28.40), q=0.0031.
JAK2 loss frequency 38% vs 5.7% in rest; OR=10.22 (95% CI 2.79-37.39), q=0.0031.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a coherent pattern of upregulation in immune/inflammatory (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and proliferation (MYC, E2F) pathways with downregulation of heme metabolism, with moderate-to-large effect sizes and FDR control. WXS shows a strong, significant enrichment of BAP1 mutations (q=0.016) and a suggestive but not significant enrichment of PBRM1 (q=0.053). CNV shows significant loss of chr9p/chr9q including CDKN2A and JAK2 loci, with large effect sizes and q<0.05. The pattern is coherent across modalities: BAP1 mutation and CDKN2A loss are both associated with aggressive ccRCC biology, and the RNA immune/proliferation signature aligns with these genomic alterations.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by a molecular profile enriched for BAP1 mutation and 9p/9q loss, with an immune/proliferative transcriptional program. These features are consistent with a biologically distinct subtype of clear cell renal cell carcinoma, but clinical implications are not directly assessed.
limitations: RNA pathway analysis is based on ssGSEA scores and may reflect tumor microenvironment composition.
WXS mutation testing was limited to 22 genes.
CNV analysis is continuous and gain/loss calls.
Availability was complete for all modalities (set n=50, rest n=53).

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: All modality median silhouettes are near zero, indicating weak internal cohesion in each modality. Patient membership support is moderate (median 2 of 4 modalities), with only 14% of patients positive in all modalities. PERMANOVA R2 values are small (2-4%), suggesting modest separation. PERMDISP is not significant after FDR for any modality. Internal structure probes show very low silhouette and high PAC, indicating no strong substructure. Boundaries to other sets are extremely weak (pair median silhouettes <0.001).
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: The set shows weak cross-modal consistency; patients are not consistently supported across modalities. The molecular and imaging features do not converge strongly on a single cohesive identity.
limitations: Structural metrics are descriptive and not independent validation.
PERMDISP is approximate due to negative eigenvalue handling.
Resampling was performed on existing SNF affinities.

limitations: Only stage and grade were assessable.

observations.finding: 23 of 50 tested pathways significant; top pathways include ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD=-0.810, down), HEME_METABOLISM (SMD=0.805, up), PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD=0.848, up), TGF_BETA_SIGNALING (SMD=0.761, up), IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING (SMD=-0.714, down).
PBRM1 mutation frequency 56.5% vs 32.5% in rest; OR=2.70 (95% CI 1.05-6.97), Fisher p=0.051, q=0.792 (not significant).
VHL mutation frequency 65.2% vs 51.3% in rest; OR=1.78 (95% CI 0.68-4.67), Fisher p=0.342, q=0.941 (not significant).
chr12p lower in set, Cliff's delta=-0.617, q=0.0008; chr16p lower in set, Cliff's delta=-0.605, q=0.0008.
CDKN2A loss frequency 0% vs 31.3% in rest; OR=0.046 (95% CI 0.003-0.793), q=0.011.
chr14q loss frequency 13.0% vs 48.8% in rest; OR=0.158 (95% CI 0.043-0.573), q=0.019.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a coherent pattern of downregulation of immune/inflammatory pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and upregulation of metabolic/TGF-beta pathways, with large effect sizes and FDR control. WXS shows no significant mutation enrichment after FDR correction; PBRM1 is suggestive but not significant (q=0.79). CNV shows a distinct pattern of lower genomic instability (lower fga, fewer losses of CDKN2A, chr9p/q, chr14q) and significant lower copy number at chr12p and chr16p. The CNV pattern is coherent and significant, while RNA is also significant but WXS is not.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by a non-inflammatory, metabolic transcriptional profile and a relatively quiet genome with fewer common ccRCC deletions. This may represent a distinct biological subtype, but the lack of significant mutation enrichment limits molecular characterization.
limitations: WXS mutation testing had limited power due to small set size (n=23) and multiple testing.
RNA pathway analysis may be influenced by stromal content.
CNV analysis was complete.
Availability was complete for all modalities (set n=23, rest n=80).
